name: ExtractPullRequests
description: Extracts PR data from Azure DevOps and generates PowerBI-compatible CSVs
author: Odd Essentials, LLC

inputs.name: organization
inputs.label: Organization
inputs.helpMarkDown: Azure DevOps organization name

inputs.name: projects
inputs.label: Projects
inputs.helpMarkDown: List of project names (one per line or comma-separated). Required in extract mode; optional in backfill-comments mode (empty = all projects eligible).

inputs.name: pat
inputs.label: Personal Access Token
inputs.helpMarkDown: PAT with Code (Read) scope. Use $(PAT_SECRET) from variable groups.

inputs.name: database
inputs.label: Database Path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to SQLite database file

inputs.name: outputDir
inputs.label: CSV Output Directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Directory for generated CSV files

inputs.name: startDate
inputs.label: Start Date (Optional)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Override start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to incremental.

inputs.name: endDate
inputs.label: End Date (Optional)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Override end date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to yesterday.

inputs.name: backfillDays
inputs.label: Backfill Days (Optional)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Number of days to backfill for convergence (e.g., 60)

inputs.name: includeComments
inputs.label: Extract PR Comments
inputs.helpMarkDown: Extract PR thread comments to compute review_time metrics. Off by default.

inputs.name: commentsMaxPrsPerRun
inputs.label: Max PRs for Comment Extraction
inputs.helpMarkDown: Maximum PRs to fetch comments for per run. Must be a non-negative integer. Defaults to 100 for rate-limit protection.

inputs.name: commentsMaxThreadsPerPr
inputs.label: Max Threads per PR
inputs.helpMarkDown: Maximum threads to fetch per PR. Non-negative integer; 0 means unlimited.

inputs.name: generateAggregates
inputs.label: Generate Aggregates
inputs.helpMarkDown: Generate JSON aggregates for the PR Insights dashboard. Adds ~5-10s to pipeline runtime. Disable if you only need CSV output.

inputs.name: aggregatesDir
inputs.label: Aggregates Output Directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Directory for aggregate JSON files (used with generateAggregates)

inputs.name: enablePredictions
inputs.label: Generate ML Predictions
inputs.helpMarkDown: Generate trend predictions using Prophet time-series forecasting. Requires generateAggregates to be enabled. Adds ~10-30s to pipeline runtime.

inputs.name: enableInsights
inputs.label: Generate AI Insights
inputs.helpMarkDown: Generate AI-powered insights using OpenAI. Requires generateAggregates and openaiApiKey. Adds ~5-15s to pipeline runtime.

inputs.name: openaiApiKey
inputs.label: OpenAI API Key
inputs.helpMarkDown: OpenAI API key for AI Insights generation. Use $(OPENAI_API_KEY) from a variable group. Required when enableInsights is true.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.label: Mode

options.backfill-comments: Backfill comment coverage for historical PRs

inputs.helpMarkDown: Which CLI subcommand to run. `extract` (default) pulls PR metadata for the configured date range and, when `includeComments` is on, also fetches comments for the most recent PRs in that window. `backfill-comments` drains `pr_threads`/`pr_comments` coverage for PRs already in the database whose `comments_extracted_at` is NULL (oldest first); it is how you catch up historical PRs after flipping `includeComments` on. Extract-only inputs (`startDate`, `endDate`, `backfillDays`, `includeComments`, `commentsMaxPrsPerRun`) are rejected in `backfill-comments` mode and vice versa.

inputs.name: backfillSince
inputs.label: Backfill: Since Date
inputs.helpMarkDown: Only backfill PRs closed on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional; omit to include all uncovered PRs.

inputs.name: backfillUntil
inputs.label: Backfill: Until Date
inputs.helpMarkDown: Only backfill PRs closed strictly before this date (YYYY-MM-DD), exclusive. Optional; omit to include all uncovered PRs.

inputs.name: backfillLimit
inputs.label: Backfill: PR Limit per Run
inputs.helpMarkDown: Maximum PRs processed this run. Non-negative integer; `0` or omitted means no limit. Use this to keep a run within your pipeline's timeout — at roughly 1 PR/second steady-state, a 60-minute pipeline comfortably handles ~3000 PRs with buffer. Re-runs are automatically resumable (already-covered PRs are excluded).
